{{Quote|Welcome aboard my vessel, the ''Fereallis''.|Captain Gideon|<ref name="LoNH" />}}
The '''''Fereallis''''' was a [[TL-1200 transport/Legends|TL-1200 transport]] owned by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gideon (Devaronian)|Gideon]], a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and leader of the [[Suwanee Pirates]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are simply going to search your vessel for anything of value, and then you can be on your way. Should any of you decide to resist paying your share of this customs duty, you will find yourself missing more than just your belongings.|Captain Gideon|<ref name="LoNH" />}}
Captain Gideon and his crew operated in and around [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] using the ''Fereallis'' to prey on unsuspecting vessels by pretending the TL-1200 transport was damaged. The pirates would send out a distress call and wait for their "rescuers" to find the ship apparently venting [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Once the victims boarded the ''Fereallis'' to render aid, the pirates would ambush them and confiscate whatever items they deemed valuable.<ref name="LoNH" />
